description: This file defines the interface 'TokenParserInterface' for token parsers in the Twig templating engine. It specifies methods for setting the parser, parsing tokens into nodes, and retrieving the associated tag name.

classes.name: TokenParserInterface
classes.description: Interface for token parsers in Twig, defining methods for parser assignment, token parsing, and tag retrieval.

methods.name: setParser
methods.description: Associates a Twig parser with this token parser.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a given Token instance and returns a Node, may throw a SyntaxError.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Retrieves the tag name associated with this token parser.
